game.title: Tomb Raider Game of the Year

roadmap.title: Story run with combat counters
roadmap.description: Play the story and keep each combat count in mind: kills by weapon, headshots, finishers, stealth kills and hunting. In Shantytown, handle the dynamite, rope and zip-line achievements before leaving, and finish every Endurance crew conversation.

roadmap.title: Free-roam cleanup
roadmap.description: After the credits, return to the island to finish the optional tombs, the 13 challenges, every document, relic and GPS cache, all 24 skills and every weapon upgrade.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer
roadmap.description: Play online matches for the 15 multiplayer achievements. Finding enough players is the main obstacle, and level 60 is a long grind.

achievements.summary: Find 25% of the documents scattered across the island.

guide.context: One fan guide counts 54 documents in 8 sets, including 10 journal entries that Lara writes at base camps. Journal entries are not marked on level maps or map keys.

steps.text: Pick up and read each document you spot while exploring.
Check each area's map key to see how many documents it holds and how many you have found.
A treasure map, or the @mechanic{Orienteering} and @mechanic{Cartography} skills, marks the remaining ones on your map.

achievements.summary: Find 75% of the documents scattered across the island.

guide.context: There are 54 documents in 8 sets spread over the island.

steps.text: Keep reading documents as you explore until you reach 75%.
Treasure maps show every document on the world map, so use them to find the missing ones.

achievements.summary: Collect 25% of the relics scattered across the island.

guide.context: There are 42 relics in 15 sets. Each set sits in one area.

steps.text: Open relic boxes as you explore. Each one adds a relic to your collection.
Look at the map for relic icons. Relics you have not found are grey.

achievements.summary: Collect 75% of the relics scattered across the island.

guide.context: The relic inside a box depends on the order you open the boxes. Some boxes can be reached only on a later visit to the area.

steps.text: Keep opening relic boxes until you hold 75% of the relics.
Check the map for grey relic icons to see which boxes you still need.

achievements.summary: Find 25% of the hidden GPS caches.

guide.context: There are 75 GPS caches. They are small, blink as you approach, and light up when Survival Instinct is on.

steps.text: Use Survival Instinct as you explore to spot caches.
Check each area's map key for the number of caches in it.

achievements.summary: Find 75% of the hidden GPS caches.

guide.context: There are 75 GPS caches in total.

steps.text: Use Survival Instinct in each area to find the remaining caches.
Treasure maps show every GPS cache on the world map.

achievements.description: Find all documents, relics and GPS caches.
achievements.summary: Find every document, relic, and GPS cache.

guide.context: One fan guide lists these totals: 54 documents, 42 relics and 75 GPS caches.

steps.text: Find the 14 treasure maps. Seven lie in levels without tombs and show every item type there. The other seven come as rewards from the optional tombs, and most of them show only some item types.
Buying the @mechanic{Cartography} skill shows every treasure map location on your map.
Use the first camp you reach in @loc{Summit Forest}. One fan guide warns that skipping it can bug Lara's journal entries.
Collect each item still marked with a question mark on the map.
Come back later for padlocked items once you have the gear they need.

achievements.summary: Collect a total of 5000 pieces of salvage.

steps.text: Open salvage crates and trunks, burn hanging salvage nets, and loot enemies and animals as you play.
Each optional tomb gives 250 salvage. @mechanic{Advanced Salvaging} and @mechanic{Bone Collector} add more.

achievements.summary: Loot 200 defeated enemies.

steps.text: Stand next to each defeated enemy and press the interact button to loot the body.

achievements.description: Purchase all skills in one category.
achievements.summary: Buy every skill in one skill category: Survivor, Hunter, or Brawler.

guide.context: Survivor has 9 skills, Hunter has 8 and Brawler has 7. Higher tiers open as you buy lower-tier skills.

steps.text: Rest at a base camp and open the @mechanic{Skills} menu.
Spend skill points until you own every skill in one category.
If you still need Former Adventurer, buy @mechanic{Dodge Kill} only after you have 25 dodge-counter incapacitations.

achievements.description: Purchase all skills in all categories.
achievements.summary: Buy every skill in the Survivor, Hunter, and Brawler categories.

guide.context: There are 24 skills: 9 Survivor, 8 Hunter and 7 Brawler.

steps.text: Spend skill points in the @mechanic{Skills} menu at base camps until all 24 skills are bought.
Buy @mechanic{Dodge Kill} and @mechanic{Dodge Kill Mastery} after you finish Former Adventurer.

achievements.description: Fully mod and completely upgrade any weapon.
achievements.summary: Fully mod and completely upgrade one weapon.

guide.context: Each weapon has parts that build its next version and salvage mods bought in the Gear menu. Some mods unlock only after an upgraded version exists.

steps.text: Choose one weapon: bow, pistol, rifle or shotgun.
Collect every part for that weapon. At a base camp, build each upgraded version in the Gear menu.
Buy every mod for that weapon with salvage in the Gear menu.

achievements.description: Fully mod and completely upgrade all weapons.
achievements.summary: Fully mod and completely upgrade all four weapons.

guide.context: Final versions are the Competition Bow, Magnum Pistol, Commando Rifle and Combat Shotgun. Parts turn a weapon into its next version at a base camp. The Compound Bow and Tactical Pistol come from the story. The part locations come from one fan site and are not independently confirmed.

steps.text: Bow: find parts in @loc{Base Exterior} and @loc{Mountain Village} (second visit) for the Recurve Bow. Find parts in @loc{Chasm Monastery} and @loc{Shipwreck Beach} (first and second visit) for the Competition Bow.
Pistol: find parts in @loc{Mountain Village} (second visit), @loc{Shantytown} and @loc{Shipwreck Beach} (second visit) for the Magnum Pistol.

Rifle: find two parts in @loc{Mountain Village} (second visit) and one in @loc{Shantytown} for the Assault Rifle. Find one part in @loc{Shantytown} and two in @loc{Shipwreck Beach} (first visit) for the Commando Rifle.

Shotgun: find parts in @loc{Mountain Village} (third visit), @loc{Shantytown} and @loc{Solarii Fortress} for the Pump-Action Shotgun. Find parts in @loc{Shipwreck Beach} (first visit), @loc{Cliffside Bunker} and @loc{Research Base} for the Combat Shotgun.
Buy every mod for all four weapons with salvage in the Gear menu.

achievements.description: Kill and loot 10 large animals (deer, boar, wolves).
achievements.summary: Take down 10 large animals (deer, boar, or wolves) and loot each body.

steps.text: Hunt deer, boar or wolves and loot each body after the kill.
@mechanic{Animal Instincts} highlights animals you can hunt.

achievements.description: Kill and loot 10 small animals (rabbits, chickens, rats).
achievements.summary: Take down 10 small animals (rabbits, chickens, or rats) and loot each body.

steps.text: Kill rabbits, chickens or rats and loot each body.
@mechanic{Animal Instincts} highlights animals you can hunt.

achievements.description: Kill and loot 10 flying animals (crows and gulls).
achievements.summary: Take down 10 flying animals (crows or gulls) and loot each body.

steps.text: Shoot crows or gulls and loot each body.
@mechanic{Animal Instincts} highlights animals you can hunt.

achievements.description: Perform 50 headshot kills in the single player campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with headshots in the single-player campaign.

steps.text: Aim at enemies' heads with any weapon. Each headshot kill adds to the count.
@mechanic{Bow Expert} and @mechanic{Pistol Expert} also give you a headshot reticle.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the bow.

steps.text: Equip the bow and kill enemies with arrows until you reach 50 kills.
@mechanic{Arrow Retrieval} returns arrows when you loot a body.

achievements.summary: Kill 75 enemies with the rifle.

guide.context: The rifle slot starts as the WWII Submachine Gun, then becomes the Assault Rifle and the Commando Rifle.

steps.text: Kill enemies with the rifle slot weapon until you reach 75 kills.

achievements.summary: Kill 40 enemies with the shotgun.

steps.text: Equip the shotgun and kill enemies with it until you reach 40 kills.

achievements.summary: Kill 35 enemies with the pistol.

steps.text: Equip the pistol and kill enemies with it until you reach 35 kills.

achievements.description: Force an enemy to drop dynamite that kills two people when exploding.
achievements.summary: Make an enemy drop dynamite that explodes and kills two people.

guide.context: This can be done in @loc{Shantytown}, where many @enemy{Solarii} throw dynamite from a distance. Do it before you leave the area.

steps.text: Find a dynamite thrower. Many wear a yellow helmet.
Shoot him as he is about to throw. Aim at a limb so he drops the dynamite instead of dying.
Choose a thrower who stands close to other enemies so the blast kills two people.

achievements.summary: Pull 5 enemies off ledges with rope arrows.

guide.context: You get rope arrows automatically in the Cliffside Village level.

steps.text: Aim the bow at an enemy who stands near a ledge and press the alternate fire button to shoot a rope arrow. The pull drops the enemy off the edge. Do this to 5 enemies.
Enemies near edges are rare, so take these chances as they come. @loc{Shantytown} is a good place.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies that have not noticed Lara.

steps.text: Kill enemies that have not spotted you, with stealth attacks or weapons, until you reach 25.
The bow kills quietly.

achievements.summary: Perform 15 finishing moves on enemies.

guide.context: The @mechanic{Dodge Counter} skill gives a steady way to set up finishers.

steps.text: Wait for an enemy to attack, then press the dodge button.
Hit melee when the on-screen button prompt appears to stun the enemy.
While the enemy is stunned, move close and press melee when the finisher prompt shows. Do this 15 times.
The Expert skills let you finish with the bow, pistol, rifle or shotgun after a stun.

achievements.summary: Shoot 10 enemies off zip lines.

guide.context: Zip-line enemies appear in @loc{Shantytown}. One guide advises a spare save before that area in case it is still unfinished when the story ends.

steps.text: In @loc{Shantytown}, start up the ladder toward @npc{Grim}, or take the cargo line in his direction.
Shoot enemies who ride zip lines until 10 have fallen.

achievements.summary: Incapacitate 25 enemies with the dodge counter.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Dodge Counter} at a base camp.
Wait for an enemy to attack, then press the dodge button.
Hit melee when the on-screen button prompt appears. Lara then stabs the enemy's knee and incapacitates him. Do this 25 times.
Buy @mechanic{Dodge Kill} only after this is done. With it, Lara kills light enemies instead of incapacitating them.

achievements.summary: Complete one optional tomb.

guide.context: Each optional tomb has a short puzzle and a treasure chest.

steps.text: Find an optional tomb entrance. @mechanic{Cartography} shows them on your map.
Solve the puzzle inside and open the treasure chest.
The Tomb of the Unworthy in @loc{Mountain Village} is near the waterfall and needs the climbing axe.

achievements.summary: Complete all 7 optional tombs.

guide.context: Each tomb has a short puzzle and a treasure chest. @mechanic{Cartography} shows every tomb entrance on the map. Each tomb gives 250 salvage, and most also give a partial treasure map. The edition's extra Tomb of the Lost Adventurer is not one of these seven, and no source says whether it is needed.

collectibles.name: Tomb of the Unworthy
collectibles.method: Reach the entrance with the climbing axe. With your torch lit, burn the three corpses hanging in the cage, push the cage up, climb past it, and open the chest at the altar.

collectibles.name: Hall of Ascension
collectibles.location: @loc{Mountain Village}, a short detour northeast on the way to the blue smoke signal; chalk marks the entrance
collectibles.method: In the big building, use the left mechanism to close the shutters. Use the front mechanism when the first shutter opens, ride the platform when the wind pushes it right, then jump onto the climbable wall and reach the chest.

collectibles.name: Well of Tears
collectibles.location: @loc{Shantytown}, in a hut in the first area, before the Ancient Gate camp
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies in the hut and use the @item{Rope Dart} to pull planks from the floor. Put three gas canisters on the cage in the main room. Jump onto the cage and throw one canister off, then step off so the cage rises. From the base-camp platform, jump onto the cage and go left to the next ledge before time runs out. The chest is in the treasure room.

collectibles.name: Chamber of Judgment
collectibles.method: Put the gas canisters on the balance closest to the entrance. Break the middle barrier with the @item{Rope Dart}, then climb the scalable wall to the chest.

collectibles.name: Stormguard Sanctum
collectibles.method: Burn the barricade with a fire arrow, then light the gas with fire arrows and move quickly. Burn a second barricade with a fire arrow, then bounce off the small kicker onto the scalable wall.

collectibles.name: The Flooded Vault
collectibles.location: @loc{Shipwreck Beach}, on the way to the Endurance wreck
collectibles.method: Defeat the two guards on the cliff and open the door. Inside, turn on the electricity upstairs and open the gate. Burn the cloth holding the raft, break the barrier with the shotgun, and pull the raft over with 2 or 3 rope darts. On the raft, shoot the rope-wrapped metal to lift the light out of the water. At the second stair set, when the countdown starts, pull the raft under the light and cross. The chest is at the top of the stairs.

collectibles.name: Temple of the Handmaidens
collectibles.method: Enter only after you take the @item{Rope Ascender} from the Endurance wreck. In the timed main room, open the valve left of the camp and cross the light beams, using the @item{Rope Dart} on the rope-covered post.

achievements.summary: Finish any one of the 13 challenges.

guide.context: Challenge items glow in Survival Instinct view.

steps.text: In @loc{Coastal Forest}, shoot 10 hanging skull totems with the bow. The first one hangs near where you get the Makeshift Longbow.

achievements.summary: Finish all 13 challenges.

guide.context: The 13 challenges are separate from the tombs. Items glow in Survival Instinct view, except the Previous Inhabitants flags. Each pickup autosaves, and you can finish leftovers in free roam after the story.

collectibles.name: Ghost Hunter
collectibles.method: Shoot 10 hanging skull totems.

collectibles.name: Pyromaniac
collectibles.location: @loc{Mountain Temple}, above the long rope ladder
collectibles.method: Shoot glass lanterns. Seven exist, but 5 are enough.

collectibles.name: Illumination
collectibles.method: Light your torch from a nearby lantern, then light the burner in the lap of each of 10 statues.

collectibles.name: Egg Poacher
collectibles.method: Raid 5 bird nests.

collectibles.name: Non-Believer
collectibles.method: Burn 5 banners with your torch.

collectibles.name: Laid to Rest
collectibles.method: Burn an effigy's cloth with a fire arrow, then pull the frame down with a rope arrow. Ten exist, but 5 are enough.
collectibles.note: Come back for the first one once you own fire arrows.

collectibles.name: Silencer
collectibles.method: Destroy crank-powered sirens with your axe. Five exist, but 4 are enough.

collectibles.name: Firestarter
collectibles.method: Burn 6 hanging sacks with fire arrows.

collectibles.name: Redcap Roundup
collectibles.method: Pick 10 mushrooms.

collectibles.name: Cairn Raider
collectibles.method: Dismantle 5 cairns topped with helmets.

collectibles.name: Minesweeper
collectibles.method: Explode 10 naval mines.

collectibles.name: Previous Inhabitants
collectibles.method: Burn 4 flags with your torch or fire arrows.
collectibles.note: The flags do not glow in Survival Instinct view. The level cannot be reached by fast travel; walk from the Survivors' Camp on Shipwreck Beach.

collectibles.name: Sun Killer
collectibles.method: Shoot 5 hanging totems.

achievements.summary: Finish the story campaign.

steps.text: Play through the story to the ending.

achievements.description: Hit a bundle of thrown dynamite in mid-flight.
achievements.summary: Shoot a thrown dynamite bundle while it is airborne.

guide.context: The ambush happens once in the @loc{Shantytown} story, so do it there.

steps.text: Equip the shotgun or rifle.
In @loc{Shantytown}, when the @enemy{Solarii} on the rooftop throw dynamite, hit a thrown bundle before it lands.
Enemies across the water throw dynamite when you try to climb the ladder to @npc{Grim}, which gives easy shots.

achievements.summary: Kill FeeFee the crab.

steps.text: At @loc{Shipwreck Beach}, meet your friends so the Gone Missing mission starts.
Go down from the camp to the beach and shoot a crab.
If no crabs appear, return to camp, wait about a minute, then go back down.

achievements.description: Finish every conversation with the Endurance crew.
achievements.summary: Finish every conversation with the Endurance crew.

guide.context: A missed conversation cannot be made up in the same playthrough. Keep talking to each person until the prompt above their head disappears. The autosave icon flashes when one person is done.

collectibles.name: Conversation 1: Whitman
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Whitman} before you start collecting 50 pieces of salvage.
collectibles.note: One source says the two Whitman talks in Coastal Forest are not required. Do them to be safe.

collectibles.name: Conversation 2: Whitman
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Whitman} again after you find the 50 pieces of salvage. Do not repair the axe first.
collectibles.note: One source says this Whitman talk is not required. Do it to be safe.

collectibles.name: Conversation 3: Roth
collectibles.location: After you help @npc{Roth} against the wolves
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Roth} after the wolf attack.

collectibles.name: Conversation 4: Roth
collectibles.location: Soon after you get the rope arrows
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Roth} before you use the zip line.

collectibles.name: Conversation 5: Sam, Reyes, Jonah
collectibles.location: @loc{Shipwreck Beach}, where you meet your friends
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Sam}, @npc{Reyes} and @npc{Jonah}.

collectibles.name: Conversation 6: Whitman, Sam, Jonah, Reyes
collectibles.location: Beach camp, before you go to the Endurance for the tools
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Whitman}, @npc{Sam} and @npc{Jonah} in camp. @npc{Reyes} is on the boat.

collectibles.name: Conversation 7: Whitman, Reyes, Jonah
collectibles.location: After you return from the Endurance
collectibles.method: Talk to @npc{Whitman}, @npc{Reyes} and @npc{Jonah}.

achievements.description: Complete a match in all multiplayer modes.
achievements.summary: Play one multiplayer match to the end in each multiplayer mode.

guide.context: A 2021 report says few people play multiplayer. Arrange a group before you start.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Multiplayer} from the main menu and finish one match in every mode.
One guide lists four modes: Free-For-All, Team Deathmatch, Rescue and Cry For Help.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemy players in multiplayer using a turret.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemy players with a turret in multiplayer.

steps.text: Find a turret on a multiplayer map and use it to kill enemy players until you reach 20 turret kills.

achievements.description: Kill a zip-lining enemy player in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy player who is riding a zip line in multiplayer.

steps.text: Shoot an enemy player while he is riding a zip line.

achievements.description: Catch a player in a snare trap in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Trap an opposing player in a snare during a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Get an enemy player caught in a snare trap during a match.

achievements.summary: Survive 10 explosions in multiplayer.

steps.text: Stay near explosions during matches and live through each one until you reach 10.

achievements.description: Revive a teammate in a multiplayer match.
achievements.summary: Revive a downed teammate in a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Play a team mode and revive a teammate who is down.

achievements.description: Win a ranked match in every multiplayer mode.
achievements.summary: Win a ranked multiplayer match in every multiplayer mode.

steps.text: Play ranked matches and win at least one in each mode.

achievements.description: In multiplayer, be the only player on your team that isn't dead or downed.
achievements.summary: Be the only member of your multiplayer team who is neither dead nor downed.

steps.text: In a team match, stay alive after every teammate is dead or downed.

achievements.description: Kill 10 multiplayer enemies using your melee attack.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemy players with melee attacks in multiplayer.

steps.text: Kill enemy players with your melee attack until you reach 10 kills.

achievements.description: Kill 2 multiplayer enemies with a single explosive.
achievements.summary: Kill 2 enemy players with a single explosive in multiplayer.

steps.text: Use one explosive on two enemy players standing close together.

achievements.description: In multiplayer, escape death 3 times by using the rope ascender.
achievements.summary: Use the rope ascender to avoid dying 3 times in multiplayer.

steps.text: When an enemy threatens to kill you, use the rope ascender to climb away. Do this 3 times.

achievements.summary: Buy a new character in multiplayer.

steps.text: Reach level 4 and buy the Solarii character Creeper for 250 salvage, or reach level 8 and buy the Survivor character Grim for 250 salvage.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10 in multiplayer.

steps.text: Play multiplayer matches and earn XP until you reach level 10.

achievements.description: Buy every upgrade and character in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade and every character in multiplayer.

guide.context: Characters cost 250 to 10,000 salvage and open at levels 4 to 60, so you must reach level 60. This edition already includes 4 characters that were once paid DLC. One source lists The General as available at Prestige 2, and no source says whether he is required.

steps.text: Play matches to earn salvage and level up.
Buy each character and upgrade as it opens.

achievements.summary: Reach level 60 in multiplayer.

guide.context: Level 60 needs 1,771,100 XP.

steps.text: Play multiplayer matches and earn XP until you reach level 60.
One 2021 report used a private Rescue match with 20 medical supplies and the longest time limit. It gave 30,775 XP per match.
